analysis.rationale: Revenue grew 35.6% YoY, EBITDA margin expanded from 8.27% to 13.68%, and debt-equity ratio dropped from 0.41 to 0.06, indicating strong operational and financial improvement.
analysis.summary: Aditya Infotech (CPPLUS) reported FY26 total revenue of ₹42,336.52 million, EBITDA of ₹5,789.74 million (13.68% margin), and PAT of ₹3,679.61 million (8.69% margin), with a recommended final dividend of ₹1.64 per share.
